headline: Adjusted profit jumps; GAAP hit by NorthStar impairment
summary_short: Adjusted EPS was $1.44 versus $0.93 a year ago, while reported EPS fell to $0.39 from $0.92 on NorthStar Clean Energy impairment and restructuring. The company reaffirmed 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $3.83 to $3.90.
summary_long: Operating revenue rose 8.0% to $2,183M, but operating expenses jumped to $2,136M from $1,540M, cutting operating income to $47M. The GAAP result carried $1.08 per share of asset impairment and restructuring charges tied to NorthStar Clean Energy. Year to date, adjusted EPS is $2.95 versus $2.66. CMS reaffirmed 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $3.83-$3.90, 2027 guidance of $4.08-$4.17 and long-term adjusted EPS growth of 6-8%.
confidence_notes: Adjusted EPS is non-GAAP; the release reconciles it to GAAP via $1.08 of impairment and restructuring and a $(0.03) other item. Deltas are computed from figures stated in the release.

drivers.explanation: Asset impairment and restructuring activities associated with NorthStar Clean Energy reduced GAAP results by $1.08 per share in the quarter.
CEO says the NorthStar restructuring strengthens the utility-focused model and improves earnings quality and financial flexibility.
